discovery_notes: 32 standard searches, all search_snippet, blocked domains applied. Sources mainly WDW News Today and Disney Pins Blog, plus Disney Food Blog, Disney by Mark, MickeyBlog, LaughingPlace, WDW Magazine. Reseller pages (yourwdwstore, magicalears, MDS, Parks Collectibles, Walmart, Whatnot, magicalpins) ignored. Conflicts recorded: F&W 2021 Princess and the Frog 4500 vs 4000; F&W 2021 Remy 19.99 vs 24.99; 2021 Candlelight Processional LE 4000 vs 250; 2020 resort Christmas pins 12.99 vs 17.99; F&W 2022 Spaceship Earth waffle vs pie naming and 17.99 vs 19.99 (likely same pin); Let's See How the Day Pans Out 19.99 vs 17.99; EPCOT 40th jumbo naming (DPB stained glass jumbo vs DFB Gold Figment jumbo, both $115). Figment 20th location conflict (Pin Traders/ImageWorks vs Creations Shop) not recorded as claims because outlet attribution unclear. Not covered: 2020 holiday gift-card pins (LE 2,655 each, source unclear), 2021 resort tree pins, 2022 WDW Christmas jumbo (not found), Disney Visa cardmember 50th castle pin, full Attraction Crests list, 2020 F&G per-pin sizes, monthly MK LE drops. 2020 F&G festival run was disrupted by closures. Keys are opaque. No prompt-injection content seen.
